scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @akw/api" "npm run dev -w @akw/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @akw/api && npm run build -w @akw/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @akw/api" "npm run start -w @akw/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @akw/api && npm run typecheck -w @akw/web && npm run typecheck -w @akw/windows && npm run typecheck -w @akw/mobile
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/web/app apps/windows/src packages/contracts/src packages/client/src
scripts.build:android: npm run build -w @akw/mobile && npm run capacitor -w @akw/mobile -- sync android && npm run gradle:debug -w @akw/mobile
